prompt: Add rate limiting to our public API — 100 requests per minute per API key. Ship it.
required_behaviors: writes tests for the acceptance criteria
produces a deployment checklist and rollback plan

prompt: Implement the password-reset flow end to end, from design through deployment.
required_behaviors: designs smallest viable change before implementing
hands off to production-code-review before considering it done

prompt: Build the CSV export feature and make sure it's production-ready.
Take this ticket with clear acceptance criteria and get it shipped, including tests.
required_behaviors: every acceptance criterion has a corresponding test

prompt: We need a deployment plan and rollback strategy for this new webhook feature we just built.
required_behaviors: addresses external side effects explicitly in the rollback plan

prompt: This ticket is ready to go, can you take it all the way through to done?
required_behaviors: treats 'all the way through to done' as including tests, review, and deployment planning
notes: No explicit engineering-workflow keywords, but 'all the way to done' implies the full pipeline.

prompt: Get the dark-mode toggle feature into production safely.
required_behaviors: produces a deployment checklist even for a seemingly low-risk feature
notes: The word 'safely' signals the need for the full checklist/rollback discipline, not just code.

prompt: We want to build something to improve retention but have no idea what yet.
forbidden_behaviors: starting implementation planning before the requirement is scoped
notes: This belongs to product-manager first — the requirement isn't clarified yet.

prompt: Users are seeing an intermittent 500 error, we don't know why.
forbidden_behaviors: treating an unknown-cause bug as a feature-implementation task
notes: This belongs to debugging-investigator — the cause is unknown, not the implementation.

prompt: Fix this typo in the button label.
forbidden_behaviors: running the full 15-step workflow for a one-line trivial fix
